name: peek-open-close-animation-frames
description: raw frame captures spanning the peek open and close transitions, for before/after comparison rather than a pass/fail number. Same fixture, gate and link coordinates as peek-dismiss-escape.json. The open capture starts immediately after the click (no settle) to catch as much of kPeekOpenDuration (0.24s) as SSH round-trip latency allows; the close capture uses key_during_capture on Escape, which backgrounds rapidcap and fires the key from inside one SSH session so the ~170ms kPeekDismissDuration window is not eaten by two separate round trips.

key_during_capture was tried here first and never dismissed the peek at all (confirmed separately: plain key escape does, on the same build) - backgrounding rapidcap ahead of the keypress appears to disturb the peek's key focus, a probe-tooling quirk unrelated to the product. Sequential key-then-capture is the reliable path, at the cost of missing the earliest frames to round-trip latency.
